name: Eurazeo SE
summary: Eurazeo SE is a private equity and venture capital firm specializing in growth capital, series C, acquisitions, leveraged buyouts, and buy-ins of a private company, and investments in upper mid-market, mid-market and listed public companies, small- and mid-cap healthcare companies, equity in the small-mid and mid-large buyout segments. The firm seeks to invest in medium-sized or large companies, SMEs, high growth companies, and real estate management and investment activities.
